format: CSV with one header per 1000-row part; empty cell is null; booleans True/False
normalization: Each clip: summed reward/(0.1*(reference_frames-1)); failed suffix contributes zero; all clips equally weighted
error_means: Within each clip, measured over actual executed transitions; units are in column names
source_clip_id: Original accepted P9 BONES manifest index; output sorted by this index
success: No physical termination before natural full-reference end; original height/tilt criteria unchanged
identity_parts: Only changed success identities; complete per-clip scores preserve all unchanged identities
